title: 慧博投研 MCP 连接配置
description: 请输入慧博投研服务的 Bearer Token，用于连接远程 MCP 服务。Token凭证仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下。请勿将 Token 分享给他人。
description_en: Please enter the Bearer Token for the Hibor Research service to connect to the remote MCP service. The token credentials are stored locally under ~/.workbuddy only. Do not share the token with others.
docLabel: 请前往 慧博开发者平台 联系客服申请 API token，申请后将 token 填入下方输入框。
docLabel_en: Visit Hibor to learn about the service and credentials

fields.label: 慧博投研服务 Token
fields.placeholder: 粘贴由服务管理员提供或通过官方渠道获取的 Token
fields.placeholder_en: Paste the token provided by your service administrator or obtained through an official channel
fields.description: 仅填写 Token 本身，不要添加“Bearer ”前缀。MCP 请求会自动通过 Authorization: Bearer 请求头发送。
fields.description_en: Enter the token only, without the 'Bearer ' prefix. The MCP request sends it in the Authorization: Bearer header.
